items.title: 31.3 X-ray crystallography aur banawat ka tajziya (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of X-ray crystallography (PDF 223-224).

blocks.text: X-ray crystallography aik bohat taqatwar tajziyati auzaar hai jo qalmi (crystalline) thos mein atoms ki teen-jehti (three-dimensional) jagahein pehchanta hai. Yeh materials science, biochemistry aur dawa-sazi ki chemistry mein ahem hai kyunke is se scientists materials ki banawat dekh sakte hain. X-rays ki wavelength bohat chhoti hai, is liye yeh shuaein molecule ya ionic compound mein electrons aur atoms ki jagahein maloom karne mein use hoti hain. Thos materials atoms ki tahon ya lariyon (strands) par mushtamil hote hain.

Jab source se X-rays crystal par parti hain to atoms se takra kar khaas zawiyon par diffract hoti hain (Figure 31.4). Diffract shuda shuaein screen par naqsh banati hain jinhein diffraction patterns kehte hain. Diffraction pattern molecule mein atoms aur electrons ki jagah batata hai; is se naqshe bante aur atoms ke darmiyan faasle maloom hote hain. Riyazi models se pattern ka tajziya kar ke scientists crystal mein atoms ki jagahon aur bond angles ka mufassal naqsha banate hain, yun atoms aur un ki electron density ka poora naqsha bana kar molecule ya crystal ki mukammal banawat maloom hoti hai. Figure 31.5 naphthalene ke liye yeh dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: surkh atoms ki teen qatarein jin ka darmiyani faasla d hai. Do mutawazi neeli X-rays theta zawiye par aati aur pehli aur doosri qatar ke atoms se mun'akis (purple) hoti hain. Chhote narangi hisse neeche wali shua ka izafi faasla dikhate hain, andar jate d sin(theta) aur bahar aate d sin(theta), kul 2d sin(theta). Daen: naphthalene ke do jure hexagons, har carbon atom par hum-markaz contour dairon ke sets.
blocks.caption: Atoms ki tahon se X-ray diffraction, aur naphthalene ka electron-density naqsha (Figures 31.4 aur 31.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Neeche wali tah se mun'akis shua 2d sin(theta) zyada faasla tay karti hai. Jahan yeh izafi rasta wavelength ka poora adad guna ho, mun'akis shuaein aik doosre ko taqwiyat deti aur roshan dhabba banta hai (n x wavelength = 2d sin(theta), Bragg ka qanoon), is liye dhabbon ke zawiye tahon ka faasla d dete hain. Naqshe par contour lakeerein barabar electron density ke nuqte jorti hain, aur har chotti aik atom dikhati hai.

blocks.text: X-ray diffraction (XRD) ka sab se mashhoor istemal DNA ki double helix banawat maloom karna hai. Yeh ab bhi enzymes aur proteins jaise pecheeda hayatiyati molecules ke tajziye mein use hota hai. Dawa sazi mein designers is se dekhte hain ke dawa ka molecule apne hadaf se kaise jurta hai. Yeh minerals, masnoi crystals aur nanomaterials ke tajziye mein bhi use hota hai, jis se electronics, optics aur tameerat mein materials ki karkardagi behtar hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Crystal mein atoms ki jagahein maloom karne ke liye X-rays kyun use hoti hain, nazar aane wali roshni kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: X-rays ki wavelength bohat chhoti, atoms ke darmiyani faaslon jitni hai, is liye atoms ki tahein inhein diffract karti hain; nazar aane wali roshni ki wavelength bohat lambi hai.

blocks.prompt: X-ray crystallography ke do istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: DNA ki double helix banawat maloom karna; enzymes aur proteins ka mutala; dawa sazi; minerals, masnoi crystals aur nanomaterials ka tajziya.

items: XRD crystals mein atoms ki 3D jagahein maloom karta.
Izafi rasta 2d sin(theta); diffraction patterns se electron-density naqshe.
